body:
Extract 2D nesting outlines from 3D models (`STEP`, `STL`, `OBJ`, and `.sc` `#1456`) and instance 2.5D/3D operations at each placed part on a router sheet.

Depends on #2158, #2160, and #2161.

## Scope

- **3D orientation and sheet-face selection (`crates/app/`, `crates/geometry/`):**
  - Allow a user to pick a planar face (`FeatureSel::Face` or `FeatureSel::Patch`) on a 3D model to lie flat on the sheet (`normal -> -Z`), or default to the model's current `-Z` base face (`z_min` seated at `z = 0`).
  - Store the chosen sheet-face orientation on the `NestPart` entry (undoable command parameter).
- **2D silhouette extraction and thickness checks (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/slice.rs`):**
  - Project the oriented 3D mesh along the sheet normal via `slice::project` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/slice.rs`) to obtain the outer loop and through-holes (`Region`).
  - Measure model height `z_max - z_min`. Refuse by model name when `model_height > sheet_thickness` within tolerance.
- **Flat-extrusion check vs 2.5D/3D router instancing:**
  - Compare `slice::at_z` cross-sections at bottom, mid, and top planes against `slice::project` to detect non-flat features (pockets, blind holes, steps, chamfers).
  - On pure 2D through-cut nests (`Kind::Waterjet`, `Kind::Plasma`), refuse non-flat 3D parts by name unless the user explicitly enables `outline_only`.
  - On `Kind::Mill` (CNC router) nests, nest using the full outer XY silhouette plus cutter diameter and gap, then replicate the part's authored 2.5D/3D operations (`Pocket`, `Drill`, `Chamfer2D`, `Contour`, `Pocket3D`) transformed to each placed instance `(tx, ty, angle_deg)` on the sheet setup.
  - Sequence all internal 2.5D/3D operations across all placed instances before outer `Contour` cutout passes so hold-down stays intact.

## Done means

Tests load a 3D `STEP`/`STL` bracket and a pocketed 2.5D plate, orient a chosen face onto the sheet, refuse parts taller than the sheet thickness by name, refuse non-flat parts on waterjet/plasma unless `outline_only` is set, and nest plus generate transformed 2.5D router toolpaths on every placed instance with outer cutouts running last.

Part of #2156
